summary: Overall risk assessment: 29% HIGH (11 seeds), 29% MEDIUM (11 seeds), 42% LOW (16 seeds). All 38 seeds are structurally blocked from certification by Gate 2 (EW Integrity). Primary risk driver is DL-026: 53 empty non-CC ExplanationWrong slots across all seeds (100% affected). Secondary risk: DL-013 template boilerplate in 5 Pack D seeds (8 slots) providing zero educational value. Critical risk: DL-010 misassigned explanations in 4 seeds (EC-020 BLOCKED, ED-010 CONTAMINATED, ED-051 MISMATCHED, EC-020 2-SLOT MISASSIGNMENT) where learners would see completely wrong-topic distractor feedback. Systemic concern: 44.7% of EC fields (17/38) rated WEAK with no governing standard citation or business interpretation. 32% of seeds exhibit DL-031 difficulty inflation (Moderate-labeled items that test Bloom's Remember level). Pack D is disproportionately affected: all 5 DL-013 seeds are Pack D; 12/19 Pack D ECs rated WEAK vs. 5/19 Pack C. Highest remediation complexity items (ED-051, ED-036, ED-016, ED-046, ED-075) require full EW re-authoring + EC major rewrites. Lowest complexity items (EC-024, EC-041, EC-052, ED-064, ED-073) need only 1 EW fill each with strong existing ECs. Currently ZERO learner-pool exposure — all seeds are Unprocessed. After full remediation: estimated +38 Certified (Domain E 228→266). Recommended execution: 3 batches (≤28 per governance-guard Rule 5), with P0 DL-010/EC-020 handled first, then DL-013 Pack D seeds, then remaining DL-026 fills.
